title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #16

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a good way to learn the correct sounds of a surah? (1 mark)
   A. Guess from English letters only
   B. Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat
   C. Learn only by writing
   D. Read as fast as possible

2. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do before sleeping according to Aisha (R.A.)? (1 mark)
   A. Recited Al-Masad three times
   B. Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   C. Slept without any remembrance
   D. Recited only Al-Fatiha standing

3. What does Surah Al-Ikhlas teach us most? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer is not needed
   B. Allah is One and has no equal
   C. Wealth saves people
   D. We should fight our neighbours

4. What does Islam teach about lying, even in jokes? (1 mark)
   A. The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   B. Lying is allowed to friends
   C. Jokes are always lies
   D. Lying is a Sunnah

5. Which best describes trustworthiness? (1 mark)
   A. Being the tallest
   B. Keeping promises and returning what you borrow
   C. Winning every game
   D. Speaking loudly

6. Zawadi prays on time but shouts at her brother. What is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting is a Sunnah
   B. Nothing is wrong
   C. Prayer is wrong
   D. Good prayer should go with good manners

7. Why is it good to have fresh breath when praying and meeting people? (1 mark)
   A. It makes prayer shorter
   B. It is respectful to Allah and to others
   C. It is not important
   D. It makes us tall

8. Which of these should you NOT do? (1 mark)
   A. Replace an old brush
   B. Share your toothbrush
   C. Rinse your brush
   D. Store the brush clean

9. What does "Al-Basir" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Most Merciful
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The King
   D. The All-Seeing

10. Which angel takes the souls at death? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Malakul Maut
   C. Raqib
   D. Jibril

11. Malakul Maut takes souls (1 mark)
   A. Whenever he likes
   B. Only from old people
   C. By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   D. Only at night

12. Why should belief in Raqib and Atid help us behave well? (1 mark)
   A. Our words and actions are recorded
   B. They laugh at us
   C. They give sweets
   D. They punish us at once

13. What is honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust
   B. Hiding things
   C. Boasting
   D. Telling lies

14. Who was Yusuf's father? (1 mark)
   A. Ismail
   B. Ibrahim
   C. Ishaq
   D. Yaqub

15. Who was the brother who helped Prophet Musa? (1 mark)
   A. Harun
   B. Ilyas
   C. Idris
   D. Yahya

16. Which example is a light najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Blood
   B. Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   C. Dog saliva
   D. Urine of an adult

17. If you are sure you made wudhu and only doubt that it broke, what should you assume? (1 mark)
   A. You are still in wudhu
   B. You are in ghusl
   C. You must never pray
   D. Your wudhu is broken

18. Which of these breaks wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Talking
   B. Sweating
   C. Eating
   D. Passing wind

19. What is a difference between a condition and a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. They are the same
   B. A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   C. A pillar is before prayer
   D. A condition is inside prayer

20. What is a mihrab? (1 mark)
   A. A type of clothes
   B. A prayer time
   C. A cap
   D. The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla

21. Roughly in which direction is the Qibla from most parts of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. South
   B. North
   C. Straight down
   D. West

22. What does "Allahu Akbar" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Glory to Allah
   B. Allah is One
   C. Allah is the Greatest
   D. All praise belongs to Allah

23. Which action shows cruelty? (1 mark)
   A. Watering a cow
   B. Feeding a goat
   C. Throwing stones at a bird
   D. Giving shade

24. Which of these is a positive use of the internet? (1 mark)
   A. Bullying
   B. Finding information for a school project with permission
   C. Watching harmful videos
   D. Meeting strangers

25. What is a good media rule? (1 mark)
   A. Share passwords
   B. Use a phone secretly
   C. Ask parents before using devices
   D. Download any app

26. Who does the dua protect from harm? (1 mark)
   A. Only animals
   B. Only adults
   C. Nobody
   D. The one who says it, by Allah's will

27. Which of these shows tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring safety
   B. Doing nothing and hoping
   C. Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   D. Blaming luck

28. Which verse tells us to greet when entering homes? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 1:2
   B. Qur'an 110:1
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 24:61

29. Which is a way to help parents at home? (1 mark)
   A. Hide
   B. Complain
   C. Sweep and wash dishes
   D. Break things

30. What does the Kaaba represent? (1 mark)
   A. The House built to worship Allah alone
   B. A palace
   C. A school
   D. A market

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid. (2 marks)

32. Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person. (4 marks)

33. Design a short role-play showing the etiquette of eating, listing at least five actions. (5 marks)

34. Explain what integrity means when using a phone. (3 marks)

35. Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents. (3 marks)

36. Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care. (3 marks)

37. Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity. (3 marks)

38. Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well. (3 marks)

39. Explain why the earliest converts are important. (3 marks)

40. Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah. (3 marks)

41. When must a child not obey a parent, and how should the child still behave? (3 marks)

42. List the first four pillars of swalah. (4 marks)

43. Name three types of media and give one example of each. (3 marks)

44. Explain tawakkul using an example. (3 marks)

45. How can a child respond politely to a friend who laughs at their modest dress? (3 marks)

46. Write the meaning of the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas, "Qul huwallahu ahad". (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat
   Correct Arabic sounds must be learned by listening to a teacher.

2. B — Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   This is reported in Al-Bukhari.

3. B — Allah is One and has no equal
   The surah declares the oneness of Allah.

4. A — The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   The Prophet was always truthful.

5. B — Keeping promises and returning what you borrow
   A trustworthy person can be relied on.

6. D — Good prayer should go with good manners
   The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals as well.

7. B — It is respectful to Allah and to others
   A clean mouth shows respect.

8. B — Share your toothbrush
   Sharing a toothbrush spreads germs.

9. D — The All-Seeing
   Al-Basir sees everything.

10. B — Malakul Maut
   Malakul Maut is the Angel of Death, also called Izrail.

11. C — By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   Nothing happens without Allah's decree.

12. A — Our words and actions are recorded
   We try to speak and do good.

13. A — Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust
   Honest people are trusted.

14. D — Yaqub
   Yusuf was the son of Yaqub.

15. A — Harun
   Harun was Musa's brother and helper.

16. B — Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   Light najasa is cleaned by sprinkling.

17. A — You are still in wudhu
   Doubt does not remove certainty.

18. D — Passing wind
   Anything from the front or back passage breaks wudhu.

19. B — A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   Conditions before, pillars inside.

20. D — The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   It marks the direction of prayer.

21. B — North
   Makkah lies to the north of Kenya.

22. C — Allah is the Greatest
   Takbir means Allah is the Greatest.

23. C — Throwing stones at a bird
   Harming animals for fun is wrong.

24. B — Finding information for a school project with permission
   Learning is good.

25. C — Ask parents before using devices
   Permission keeps children safe.

26. D — The one who says it, by Allah's will
   Allah protects.

27. C — Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   Do your part and trust Allah.

28. D — Qur'an 24:61
   Surah An-Nur 24:61.

29. C — Sweep and wash dishes
   Helping is a duty.

30. A — The House built to worship Allah alone
   Ibrahim and Ismail built it.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands; sit; say Bismillah; eat with right hand; eat from in front; do not criticise; say Alhamdulillah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action, up to 5.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Doing the right thing even when nobody sees, because Allah sees and angels record. For example not cheating or copying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for Allah sees, 1 mark for example.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: They believed when it was hard, supported the Prophet morally and materially, and encouraged others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: When a parent commands something Allah forbids. The child should still treat them kindly and politely.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the case, 1 mark for not obeying, 1 mark for kindness.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Print: newspaper; broadcast: radio; internet: video website.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type with example.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, explain that they dress that way because of their faith, and do not insult back.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for explaining, 1 mark for not insulting.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say: He is Allah, the One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "Say" and 1 mark for "Allah is One".
